FOUNDRY_TRANSLATE.Glossary.Files.Heading: Glossary files
Edit names together in CSV or JSON, then review each change before saving. The original source name identifies an entry. Entries omitted from a file are never deleted.
FOUNDRY_TRANSLATE.Glossary.Files.ExportH: Exports all saved entries, including disabled ones. Synchronize names first to collect missing originals. Context is a short excerpt from the adventure and may contain spoilers. JSON is suitable for backups; CSV uses UTF-8, comma-separated quoted cells, and JSON arrays for aliases. Keep source names and category codes unchanged unless correcting a category.
FOUNDRY_TRANSLATE.Glossary.Files.ImportH: CSV columns: source, replacement, category; optional aliases, enabled, notes, context, language, mode. Category: character, location, faction, deity, item, lore, term. An empty replacement preserves the source name. Aliases use a JSON array, e.g. ["short name"]. Context is reference only. New entries are selected automatically; changes to existing entries require selection. A different target language, duplicate names or conflicting aliases block import. Importing an unreviewed entry also marks it as manually approved.
